issue.body:
Not entirely sure to file this here or in uvicorn.

I attempted to install the newest version of both starlette and uvicorn on a fresh Python 3.7.2 environment, but even the first example on https://www.starlette.io/ is unable to run and produces the following stacktrace:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 12, in <module>
    uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)
  File "/Users/henrik/Development/starlettetest/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/main.py", line 184, in run
    server.run()
  File "/Users/henrik/Development/starlettetest/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/main.py", line 213, in run
    config.load()
  File "/Users/henrik/Development/starlettetest/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/config.py", line 119, in load
    self.lifespan_class = import_from_string(LIFESPAN[self.lifespan])
  File "/Users/henrik/Development/starlettetest/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/importer.py", line 23, in import_from_string
    raise exc from None
  File "/Users/henrik/Development/starlettetest/env/lib/python3.7/site-packages/uvicorn/importer.py", line 20, in import_from_string
    module = importlib.import_module(module_str)
  File "/usr/local/Cellar/python/3.7.2_1/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.7/lib/python3.7/importlib/__init__.py", line 127, in import_module
    return _bootstrap._gcd_import(name[level:], package, level)
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1006, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 983, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 953, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 219, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1006, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 983, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 965, in _find_and_load_unlocked
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'uvicorn.lifespan'
```

I've previously used Starlette with no issue, but using the latest versions I'm unable to get past this stack trace.

Steps to reproduce:

1) Make a fresh Python 3.7.2 environment
2) Run `pip3 install starlette uvicorn`
3) Run the first example listed on https://www.starlette.io/

Versions used:

starlette: 0.9.11
uvicorn: 0.4.0
issue.title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'uvicorn.lifespan'
